name: Find a contact id by email or phone
description: Check whether a contact exists and get its id, using one identifier. Use after create_contact fails with duplicate_parameter, or before creating, to avoid the error. Works with the browser session only (no API key).

execution.auth: Cookie session of the logged-in app.brevo.com user, sent with the request (fetch credentials: include). No API key. Replayed from inside the app page only; behavior from outside a browser (CSRF, CORS, session expiry) was not tested.

verification.notes: Observed in UI traffic, then replayed from inside the logged-in page. Returned {is_exist: true, contactId: 2} for an existing email. Only the email parameter was tested.
